blocks.text: This is to certify that Mr./Ms. ________________________________________ was a bonafide student of this school from ______ to ______ in Class __________ (Roll No. ______). During his/her stay, his/her academic performance, conduct and character were found to be very good / excellent. He/She is hardworking, disciplined and co-operative. We wish him/her every success in future endeavours. This certificate is issued upon his/her request for ____________________ purpose.
This letter is valid with the school seal only. / छाप बिना यो प्रमाणपत्र मान्य हुने छैन।
